title: bin/shoot's touch stitch keeps sticky and fixed elements where the page puts them
why: In bin/shoot's touch stitch (#2075), setting a sticky element to static moves its absolute children: a sticky header's dropdown lands at y 900. Fixed pseudo-elements and `background-attachment: fixed` repeat on each tile (coordinator 09:14 CST Nov 8).
note: Fix 1: use position relative with insets auto, then restore. Fix 2: hide fixed pseudo-elements with a marker attribute, and use background-attachment scroll after tile 1. Follow-up on #2075, which cites this step; lane shoot-touch-per-size. Done check: a red test where a stitched shot keeps a sticky header's dropdown in place and shows a fixed background once. Filed by triage 09:15 CST Nov 8. Back to ready 07:22 CST Nov 12 (coordinator yes 07:21 CST): no live lane (was [ended:lane:-shoot-touch-per-size]).
